primary_task: Implement or debug data fetching in an Expo app (e.g. add React Query-based API calls with loading/error/empty/content states and error handling) by writing the code in the project.

requirements.name: read/write/edit project files
requirements.evidence: code examples such as "// app/_layout.tsx" and "// api/client.ts" to be written into the project
requirements.basis: "write": "create and overwrite files" ; "edit": "edit existing files and Jupyter notebooks"

requirements.name: npm packages (@tanstack/react-query, expo-secure-store, SWR, NetInfo)
requirements.evidence: "Complex app -> React Query (TanStack Query)" / "Simpler needs -> SWR or custom hooks" ; "Token storage -> expo-secure-store" (chosen per request; plain fetch needs none)
requirements.basis: "bash": "... install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, ...)"

requirements.name: bundled references (expo-router-loaders.md, offline-and-cancellation.md)
requirements.basis: "read": "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)" (manifest does not say whether the skill's references are installed)

requirements.name: npx submit-expo-feedback
requirements.evidence: "Only submit when you have something specific and actionable to report." (optional feedback)

notes: The deliverable is code written into the project; no runtime device or Expo service is needed by the document. Running the app on a phone/emulator or calling the user's real API is not required by the document (physical devices are lacking, and the user's API host would likely be outside the allow-list) - if a request demanded verifying a live request against an external API, that step would be refused. The feedback command is optional and would be a forbidden external write.
